role_definition.description: Master role as Senior Product Designer & Frontend Implementer. Follows prompt structure, non-negotiable design standards, and token-first architecture.

qa_gate.description: Baseline acceptance checklist mandatory for every design task. Verified pass/fail report required before task completion.

decisions.title: S.K.Y. Mobile Index Screens (I1–I5)
decisions.geometry_rule: Zero circles, rings, or arcs across all concepts, except circular photo thumbnails in I5 pills.

zones.HOME: Image A (warm treatment studio: window, linen, oak)
zones.VILLA: Image B (Mediterranean stone terrace: balustrade, curtain, pool)
zones.INJECT: Image C (clinical macro: glass ampoule on pale stone)

deliverables.layout: Physical card hand stack viewed from above with 2-3 deg rotation, 90px lower strip reveals with zone names and gold indices, large display word behind stack.
Enormous S-K-Y letters stacked vertically with SVG clipPath photo fills (A, B, C), zone titles and gold indices to the right, thin gold hairlines.
Strict 2x2 grid with 10px paper gutters, top-left paper cell with brand wordmark and display word, remaining 3 cells carry full-bleed photography with lower-left label/gold index.
Vertical 35mm film strip down center (656px width, 56%) with square paper sprocket holes along borders, 3 photo frames (4px paper gaps), side margins with 90 deg rotated zone names and gold indices.

Full-bleed Mediterranean villa terrace (Image B) background, upper white wordmark, lower half 3 floating paper pills (#F4F1EC) staggered horizontally with circular photo thumbnails, gold indices, and dark serif zone names.
Deep espresso #3A2A20 background with flowing liquid silk curves, 4 frosted glass cards (86% width, 24px radius, 1px white border 40%), bronze index numerals, descriptors, and 92px bottom nav.

Vertical seam at 48%, warm sand #E7D3BC left, near-black #141210 right, tall frosted dropper bottle lit from left on seam, split-color typography switching dark to bone white at 48%, brass hairlines #9C7C4A, 92px split bottom nav.

Paper white #FAF8F5 with heavy film grain, 2x2 grid with 8px white gutters, desaturated high-contrast photography, large condensed black titles (#0B0B0B) overlapping tile edges, coral #C8503C indices, small top-left S.K.Y., 92px bottom nav.

Near-black #1A1A1A to bronze #5E4B43 dark theme gradient, full-width gold hairline, 4 horizontal glass panels (90% width, 20px radius, 1px gold top edge #B08D57) with square photo thumbnails, gold indices, ivory serif titles, 92px dark nav.

Bone #F1EDE6 background, 4 vertical panels (34%/26%/22%/18%) with 4px bone gutters slicing continuous treatment room with vertical offsets, rotated 90 deg vertical labels, single sharp terracotta #B5775A glass bottle overlapping 3 panels, 92px bone nav.
